item.title: The Amir concludes a European tour of Switzerland and Germany
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani concluded a European tour comprising state visits to Switzerland and then Germany, departing from Cologne Bonn Airport. The Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs accompanied him throughout; he was seen off by Nathanael Liminski, North Rhine-Westphalia Minister for Federal, European and International Affairs and the Media, and Qatar's Ambassador to Germany Abdullah bin Ibrahim Al Hamar.

item.title: North Rhine-Westphalia to open an economic office in Doha
item.description:
The Ministry of Commerce and Industry signed a strategic cooperation agreement in Bonn with NRW.Global Business, the state's trade and investment promotion agency, under which North Rhine-Westphalia will open a regional economic office in Doha. The Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani and Minister-President Hendrik Wüst witnessed the signing on the sidelines of the Qatari-German Economic Dialogue. The office will focus on investment, industrial cooperation, digital transformation, artificial intelligence and the energy transition.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/22/11/2026/prime-minister-minister-president-of-german-state-of-north-rhine-westphalia-witness-signing-of-strategic-cooperation-agreement · Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/21/11/2026/%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%85%D8%AC%D9%84%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AE%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%A9%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%B4%D9%87%D8%AF%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%88%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%B9-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A · Al Raya (QNA) https://www.raya.com/2026/11/21/%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%82%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%AA%D9%8A%D8%AC%D9%8A-%D9%85%D8%B9-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%84%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9

item.title: Rubaiya Qatar opens its first edition with 120 artists from 45 countries
item.description:
Qatar Museums opened the first edition of Rubaiya Qatar, the international contemporary art quadrennial, with more than 120 artists from 45 countries, running until 30 April 2027. Its headline exhibition, Unruly Waters, explores water and its ties to people, ecology and geography, and the opening coincides with the anniversary of the FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/rubaiya-qatar-debuts-with-over-120-artists-exhibitions-to-foster-dialogue · Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/21/11/2026/%D9%85%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%AD%D9%81-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%AA%D8%AA%D8%AD-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B3%D8%AE%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84%D9%89-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B1%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D9%85%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A3%D9%83%D8%AB%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-120-%D9%81%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%A7-%D9%85%D9%86-45-%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A9

item.description:

item.title: Qatar's swimmers win 8 medals at the Arab championships in Manama
item.description:
Qatar's swimming team added 8 medals on day two of the 5th Arab Aquatics Championships in Manama: 5 gold, 2 silver and 1 bronze. Qatar won gold in the open 4x200m freestyle relay, Emile Fouzai took gold in the 800m freestyle, and Hamza Shaalan won the 100m breaststroke for the 17-18 age group.

item.title: Bahrain repels fresh Iranian aerial attacks with no injuries
item.description:
The Bahrain Defence Force General Command said its air defences intercepted several Iranian aerial attacks targeting the Kingdom, with falling debris causing minor material damage and no injuries, hours after the Interior Ministry reported a fire at a civilian industrial facility caused by an Iranian attack. Bahrain had sent two letters to the UN Secretary-General and the Security Council president about the attacks of 17 and 18 November.
Sources: Al Sharq (QNA) https://www.al-sharq.com/article/22/11/2026/%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A9-%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%AF%D8%AA-%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AA%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%A1%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A5%D9%8A%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/21/x/7627535 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-conflict-bahrain-intercepts-iranian-attacks-as-tehran-prepares-14-oil-tankers-to-breach-us-naval-blockade-1.500756662 · News of Bahrain https://www.newsofbahrain.com/en/article/bahrain-files-un-letters-on-iran

item.title: Coalition intercepts a Houthi ballistic missile fired at western Saudi Arabia
item.description:
The spokesman for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen, Major General Turki Al Malki, said overnight Saturday that a ballistic missile fired by the Houthis toward Saudi Arabia's western region was intercepted and destroyed. The region hosts vital energy facilities, notably the Yanbu South crude export terminal linked to the East-West pipeline, and the Jazan refinery.
Sources: Masrawy (Reuters) https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/22/3082415/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81-%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AA%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B6-%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%AE-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AD%D9%88%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%D8%AF%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%86%D8%B7%D9%82%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A9 · Khaberni https://www.khaberni.com/news/869217 · Al Mashhad https://www.almashhad.news/news/509009

item.title: Thousands take part in Dubai Run on Sheikh Zayed Road
item.description:
Dubai Run 2026 got under way this Sunday morning on Sheikh Zayed Road, with thousands taking part on the 5km and 10km routes as part of the Dubai Fitness Challenge. Authorities closed Sheikh Zayed Road, Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Boulevard, Lower Financial Centre Street and Al Sukook Street from 3am to 10am and urged motorists to use alternative routes.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/dubai/dubai-run-2026-thousands-take-over-sheikh-zayed-road-as-it-turns-into-a-giant-running-track-1.500756635 · Khaleej Times https://www.khaleejtimes.com/uae/dubai-run-2026-road-closures-metro-timings-salik-tolls

item.title: UAE warns families about content in the upcoming GTA game
item.description:
The UAE National Drug Enforcement Authority warned about content in the upcoming game GTA VI, especially scenes of drug abuse and illegal activity, citing possible harm to children's awareness and behaviour. It urged families to supervise their children's gaming and check age ratings, stressing that protection is a shared responsibility that starts with awareness and parental oversight.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/government/uae-drug-authority-issues-warning-to-parents-over-gta-6-1.500756504 · Emarat Al Youm https://www.emaratalyoum.com/local-section/other/2026-11-21-1.2105150

item.title: Oman's National Day celebrations continue as Gulf states light up landmarks
item.description:
Oman's National Day celebrations continue with military parades, drone shows and popular events from Musandam to Dhofar, as GCC states light up landmarks in the colours of the Omani flag. According to the Omani Embassy in Kuwait, the economy grew by an average of 3.2% a year between 2021 and 2025, while public debt fell from 65.9% to 34.6% of GDP.
Sources: Kuwait Times https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54103/kuwait/oman-celebrates-national-day-with-strong-economic-gains-development-milestones/ · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7627262

item.title: Egypt's forecasters warn of dense fog on roads until 9am
item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority warned of fog, at times dense, from 4am to 9am this Sunday on roads to and from the north, Greater Cairo, the Canal cities, central Sinai and northern Upper Egypt, with a 30% chance of light rain on the north-west coast, the northern Delta and Halayeb and Shalateen. Cairo will see a high of 26°C and a low of 17°C, and Aswan 33°C.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/22/3082417/%D8%B4%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D9%83%D8%AB%D9%8A%D9%81%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%AE%D9%81%D9%8A%D9%81%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B7%D9%82%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%82%D8%A8%D9%84%D8%A9 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7189572 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/21/x/7627056

item.title: Dollar steady at EGP 53.87 selling in Egyptian banks
item.description:
The dollar held steady against the pound at the start of trading this Sunday at EGP 53.77 buying and EGP 53.87 selling at the National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr, CIB and most banks, while the Central Bank of Egypt quoted EGP 53.74 buying and EGP 53.88 selling.
Sources: Cairo24 https://www.cairo24.com/2533317 · Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7626881

item.title: Gold in Egypt opens the week steady, 21-carat at EGP 5,465
item.description:
Gold prices in Egypt opened Sunday little changed from the weekly close, with 21-carat at about EGP 5,465 a gram, 24-carat at EGP 6,246 and the gold pound at EGP 43,720. This follows the ounce's biggest weekly loss since March, and 21-carat has now shed about EGP 2,090 from its record of EGP 7,600 on 2 March 2026.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7627451 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7189359

item.title: Suspect held within 6 hours over killing of party official in Santa
item.description:
Security forces in Gharbia arrested, within 6 hours, the suspect in the killing of Ayman Sayed Ahmed Abu Zeid, secretary-general of the Mostaqbal Watan party in Santa district, who died of a stab wound to the neck in the village of Eshnaway after leaving a customary reconciliation session. The body was taken to Tanta General Hospital's morgue at the disposal of the public prosecution.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_regions/details/2026/11/22/3082439/%D8%B6%D8%A8%D8%B7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AA%D9%87%D9%85-%D8%A8%D8%A5%D9%86%D9%87%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D8%AD%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%A9-%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%85-%D9%85%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%82%D8%A8%D9%84-%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%86%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%BA%D8%B1%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A9 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7189582

item.title: 1,700 cooperative housing units planned in Port Said in 3 phases
item.description:
The head of the General Authority for Building and Housing Cooperatives, Major General Walid El-Baroudi, announced a protocol with Port Said governorate to build 1,700 cooperative housing units in 3 phases, the first comprising 500 units of 90 square metres, with priority for previous applicants.

item.title: Al Ahly meet leaders Pyramids tomorrow in Egyptian league showdown
item.description:
Al Ahly wrap up preparations today for the round-nine Egyptian Premier League showdown with Pyramids tomorrow, Monday, at Cairo International Stadium. Pyramids lead with a perfect 24 points and Al Ahly are second, unbeaten on 20, while Pyramids chase a first-ever third straight win over Al Ahly.
Sources: Youm7 https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/11/22/x/7625658 · Shorouk News https://www.shorouknews.com/news/view.aspx?cdate=21112026&id=7fb72570-cb6a-47ab-ba7d-aed0e6214940

item.title: COP31 nears a final deal after a new package from Australia and Turkey
item.description:
COP31 talks in Antalya neared a final deal after the presidencies, Australia and Turkey, unveiled a new package they hope will win consensus. COP31 President Murat Kurum told a late-night plenary that the new text addressed concerns over fossil fuels and adaptation finance for developing countries. A session to approve the deal begins at 0600 GMT (9am Doha) this Sunday, after an objection window that closes at 0300 GMT.
Sources: RTE (Reuters) https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2026/1122/1600166-cop31-turkey/ · Arab News (Reuters) https://www.arabnews.com/world/cop31-climate-talks-close-to-final-deal-says-summit-president-3013430

item.title: 128 states agree to draft an international instrument on killer robots
item.description:
The 128 states party to the Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons in Geneva agreed to launch the elaboration of an international instrument on lethal autonomous weapons systems, known as killer robots, over the next two years. The deal came after five days of gruelling talks, with nearly 100 nations pushing for swift binding rules while arms producers including the United States, Russia and Israel opposed.
Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/nations-agree-to-draft-rules-for-killer-robots-at-arms-control-summit · Oman Observer (AFP) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199982/world/europe/countries-open-to-international-pact-on-killer-robots

item.title: Child dies of measles in Virginia as US cases reach 5,838
item.description:
Virginia's health department announced the death of a child under five who had contracted measles, the state's first measles death this year. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has recorded 5,838 measles cases nationwide so far through November, the worst outbreak in decades, after the country lost its measles-elimination status.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/22/3082435/%D9%88%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%A9-%D8%A3%D9%88%D9%84-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A9-%D9%88%D9%81%D8%A7%D8%A9-%D9%84%D8%B7%D9%81%D9%84-%D8%A8%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B3-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%B5%D8%A8%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D8%B1%D8%AC%D9%8A%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%83%D9%8A%D8%A9 · Cairo24 (Reuters) https://www.cairo24.com/2533312

item.title: Displaced Gazans in Deir el-Balah protest strikes and demolitions despite ceasefire
item.description:
Hundreds of displaced Palestinians protested near the "Yellow Line" in Deir el-Balah against intensifying Israeli air strikes and demolitions, with Maghazi mayor Mohammed Musleh saying more than 500 housing units had been destroyed in less than a month. Medical sources in Gaza reported 9 bodies and 55 injured received in 48 hours, bringing the toll since the 11 October 2025 ceasefire to 1,671 killed.

item.title: Boca Juniors win the Copa Sudamericana for the third time
item.description:
Argentina's Boca Juniors won the Copa Sudamericana for the third time, beating Brazil's Atletico Mineiro 2-0 in the final in Barranquilla, Colombia, with goals from Santiago Ascacibar and Miguel Merentiel. It is the club's first continental title in 18 years, under former UAE coach Rodolfo Arruabarrena.
